defect.cause: The canonical updateEntity calls refreshHealthBar(e) for every alive unit every simulation step, even with unchanged HP. The accepted damage path already refreshes the victim immediately.
defect.reproduction: Run the entire canonical server with tests/roblox_server_harness.lua and count model FindFirstChild('HealthBar') calls. On unmodified main two healthy cooldown-locked units each perform a redundant search per Heartbeat; a moving healthy unit also searches needlessly.

fix: Keep immediate victim health-bar refresh in the damage branch; remove the end-of-tick idle refresh. Preserve damage widths, movement, combat and cleanup.
character_impact: PON, GUARDON, TANKURU and JUNK HP, combat, prices, spawn and movement unchanged; only healthy-unit HealthBar searches removed.

tests.negative_control: The unmodified main source fails the new idle-lookup assertion. The pinned whole-server old fixture is checked when compatible.

evidence.main_qa_note: Both jobs succeeded; main is a one-commit status-only descendant.

next_action: Create draft PR, require exact-head offline and compile_hold success, then independent REVIEWER handles main integration. Roblox device/engine performance remains unverified.
